title: Sweet Potato Fritters with Mellow Cheese
description: A classic Italian-inspired dish featuring sweet potato fritters topped with melted mellow cheese. Perfect as a snack or side.
instructions: Grate the sweet potatoes and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a bowl, combine the flour, eggs, and grated sweet potatoes.
Add the mellow cheese and italian seasoning to the bowl.
Form the mixture into patties and place on a baking sheet.
Bake the fritters in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve hot with additional mellow cheese on top.
